description: Source code defining the FloatLayout class in the Kivy UI framework, including layout logic and widget positioning.

classes.name: FloatLayout
classes.description: A layout class in Kivy that positions child widgets using floating hints and absolute positioning.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FloatLayout, binding layout update triggers to property changes.

methods.name: do_layout
methods.description: Performs layout calculations, setting size and position of child widgets based on size hints and pos hints.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the layout and binds layout update triggers to its position.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the layout and unbinds layout update triggers from its position.
